title: BROWSER OPEN FRAMES #34062 A/B: Shift-Cmd-L alone in a browser pane (2 browser tabs), 13 real HID presses, each undone by closeTab
why: Lead 2026-11-03: Shift-Cmd-L p50 with an efficiency-core start rose 11.8 -> 14.7 ms in the bcpp films (4 presses per film); an A/B of this press alone, 3 interleaved rounds per arm, says whether #34062 causes it.

the layout and the load settle (nothing observable to wait on)
set-up or undo by the socket: openBrowser
the first browser tab loads
set-up or undo by the socket: openBrowser
the second browser tab loads
